issues.summary: ResolvedModule exposed mutable collection instances and aliased the caller-supplied references list, allowing drift between the public surfaces and the lookup map.
issues.fix: Defensive-copied references into a frozen array at construction; wrapped References, UnresolvedReferences, and Diagnostics in ReadOnlyCollection<T>.

issues.summary: Tests did not cover ResolvedToObjectModel, ResolvedViaWithFlattening peek-through, real non-emitted AST node lookup miss, severity mapping for WithBlockFlatteningDeferred and MemberAccessOnUnresolvedTarget, or exact per-entry equivalence of Resolve vs ResolveModule.
